description.en: Translates English thinking blocks into Chinese using the model channels already configured in Harness — no separate setup. Translations persist with the session, a fallback route takes over when the primary fails, and system error notices are translated too.
description.zh: 读取 Harness 上已配置的模型渠道，自动把英文思考过程译成中文，无需单独配置。译文随会话存储，不重复翻译也不残留；主路由失败自动切备用；系统报错也一并译出。
